name: Is the cost of final detail work typically included in the overall project estimate?

mainEntity.name: Is the cost of final detail work typically included in the overall project estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the cost of final detail work, including labor and materials for touch-ups and cleaning, is typically factored into the overall project estimate provided by Frasheski Construction. Our estimates aim to be comprehensive, covering all phases from initial construction to the finishing touches. Unexpected issues discovered during this phase that require substantial rework, however, would be discussed and potentially scoped as a change order.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of final detail work is generally included in the overall project estimate; significant unexpected issues may result in a change order.
